sites.name: Tan Lap Floating Village
sites.event: A typical eco-tourism area of the Dong Thap Muoi region with endless melaleuca forests and a unique path through the forest.

sites.name: Hundred-Column House
sites.event: An ancient house with unique architecture in the style of Hue's traditional wooden house, built from 120 precious logs (actually having 120 columns) between 1901 and 1903.

sites.name: Vam Nhut Tao Relic Site
sites.event: The site marking the glorious feat of hero Nguyen Trung Truc in burning the French colonial ship L'Esperance (Hope) in 1861.

sites.name: Ton Thanh Pagoda
sites.event: The place where poet Nguyen Dinh Chieu lived, taught, practiced medicine, and composed the tragic and heroic 'Van te nghia si Can Giuoc'.

sites.name: Lang Sen Wetland Reserve
sites.event: The 7th Ramsar site of Vietnam, conserving the typical ecosystem of the Dong Thap Muoi wetland.

sites.name: Nguyen Huynh Duc Tomb
sites.event: The tomb complex of 'Tiger General' Nguyen Huynh Duc - one of the founding meritorious officials of the Nguyen Dynasty.

sites.name: Rach Cat Fort
sites.event: One of the most solid military fortresses in Indochina, built by the French colonialists in 1903 to control the estuary.

sites.name: Endless Field Tourist Area (Dong Thap Muoi Medicinal Herb Conservation Area)
sites.event: The main setting of the famous movie 'The Endless Field', conserving precious medicinal genetic resources.

sites.name: Phuoc Loc Tho Ancient Village
sites.event: A gathering place of many ancient wooden houses bearing the identities of the three regions (North - Central - South) restored and preserved.

sites.name: Long An Monument Park 'Loyal and Courageous, Entire People Fighting the Enemy'
sites.event: A large-scale cultural and historical work, recognizing the noble title bestowed upon the province by the Central Committee of the National Liberation Front of South Vietnam.

sites.name: Binh Ta Archaeological Site
sites.event: A relic cluster belonging to the Oc Eo culture, proving the brilliant development of the ancient Funan kingdom in this land.
